Gabe (security): RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/3123456789 — brief note + actions below. Please read and ack if you own something. :mag:
Lina (private-deploy): TL;DR: token-rotation job failed due to an expired signing cert in the control-plane CA chain. Result: private deployments lost control-plane auth for ~48m; reporters saw '401/conn reset' and automated reconnects thrashing. No customer data was accessed.
Tom (infra): Root cause: cert-chain pruning script removed an intermediate cert early during a maintenance window; rotation job didn't detect missing chain and issued new tokens that validation rejected. See timeline in doc section 1.2.
Gabe (security): Skim highlights for people catching up:
```
Impact window: 2026-08-05 05:10–05:58 UTC
Affected: private control-plane fleets in apac and eu regions (~private tenants: 14 clusters)
Symptom: 401 auth failures, reconnect storms, transient request loss for tenant control RPCs
Mitigation: re-stitched CA chain, reissued rotation certs, and restarted rotation job at 05:46 UTC
Customer notices: draft sent to CS for review
```
Rosa (customer-success): CS signal: 6 enterprise tenants reported incidents; two opened high-priority tickets. We're preparing targeted comunicaciones and mitigation instructions for private deploy customers.
Tom (infra): Action items (owner — due):
- Tom: add preflight validation for cert-chain completeness in the rotation job (PR + CI) — due 2026-08-09.
- Lina: create a playbook for emergency CA re-stitch and add step-by-step commands + rollback checks — due 2026-08-08.
- Gabe: audit cert-pruning scripts and add safety gates to prevent removal of in-use intermediates — due 2026-08-11.
- Rosa: finalize customer-facing note and send targeted emails to impacted tenants with remediation steps & offer for dedicated support call — due 2026-08-06 09:00 PT.
- Vik: prioritize an infra task to add rotation observability (per-tenant token-validity metrics) in next sprint — due 2026-08-18.
EchoBot: Actions exported: https://redwood.internal/actions/3123456789 — please confirm ownership there.
Lina (private-deploy): Mitigation we ran: re-upload CA chain and forced rotation with `rotator.reissue(force=true, tenants=affected)`; restart event: 2026-08-05 05:46 UTC (deploy-id: dpl-12177).
Gabe (security): Note: no keys were exfiltrated; tokens issued while chain was incomplete were rejected by agents. We logged all failed auth attempts and have evidence in the doc.
Vik (vp-eng): Two asks: (1) ensure the customer note is explicit about scope and remediation ETA; (2) Tom/Gabe — add an automated smoke test for private tenant reconnection after rotation.
Tom (infra): I'll own the smoke test and post results in this thread — ETA 2026-08-10 11:00 PT.
Rosa (customer-success): I'll post the customer note draft here by 2026-08-06 07:30 PT for quick review.
Gabe (security): Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read and accepted action items. I'll follow up in the tracker after office hours.
